hook: Kadem water cut for paddy *deferred* after farmer road blocks
hook_b: Kadem water cut for paddy *deferred* after farmer road blocks
tldr: Irrigation officials postponed stopping Kadem dam water for farms, scheduled from Nov 9.

beats.what: A revised date for the suspension will be announced soon.
beats.why: On Nov 3 officials said water would be held for drinking needs from Nov 7; farmers protested in Nirmal and Mancherial.
beats.care: It shows the tension between summer drinking water and standing crops in a dry year.

causes.label: Plan to save water for summer 2027

effects.label: Paddy at booting stage saved for now

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: farmers from Rampur, Thimmapur, Chintaguda and Thapalapur blocked roads.

cards.q: Should dam water go first to crops now or drinking water in summer?

qs: If water goes to crops till late November, how much is left for summer?

facts.t: The original plan held Kadem water for drinking until *summer 2027*.

viz.verdict: Farmers gain time; summer drinking reserve still in question

steps.e: Water to be kept for drinking from Nov 7

sources.title: Kadem dam water supply suspension deferred after farmer protests

fact: Farmers' road blockades forced officials to *defer* Kadem dam's irrigation shutoff.
twist: Officials had planned to reserve Kadem water only for drinking until summer 2027.
